# `hub.role_capabilities`

Frozen default capability projection for each concrete role.

Database: `hub`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | VARCHAR(12) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Concrete role receiving this default capability. |
| `capability` | VARCHAR(128) | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Command capability granted by default to the role. |
| `required_role` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | primary key 3 | — | — | Registry role threshold that produced this row; authenticated represents no threshold. |
